request: Analyze GSE136623 and GSE140633 for PMID 33042761 (IRF4 in Skeletal Muscle Regulates Exercise Capacity via PTG/Glycogen Pathway.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Kapa stranded mRNA, HiSeq3000 SE50; Bowtie2 + RSEM; TMM; edgeR) (S4.17.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: GAS muscle, 3 MI4KO + 3 MI4OE mice (S4.17.p1); GEO: 3 'IRF4 knock out' + 3 'IRF4 overexpression', male, gastrocnemius
final.exercise_factor: none: the RNA-seq compares genotypes only; no exercised vs sedentary animals were sequenced. Exercise effects in the paper (Irf4 up after training/acute bout, Fig 1a,b; PTG down after acute exercise, Fig S5f,g) are qPCR/western only (S2.1.p1, S2.5.p2).
final.primary_estimand: Genotype effect in GAS muscle: MI4OE vs MI4KO (results normalized to MI4KO) (S2.5.p1). Not an exercise effect.
planned_contrasts: MI4OE vs MI4KO in GAS (S2.5.p1; paper: 872 DEGs, 312 up / 560 down)
final.paper_method: edgeR on RSEM expected counts with TMM normalization (S4.17.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.5.p1 and S4.17.p1 describe two RNA-seq assays: SOL MI4KO vs flox (GSE140633) and GAS MI4OE vs MI4KO (GSE136623). Data availability S4.20.p1 names both. Neither assay includes an exercise arm; exercise biology in the paper is measured by qPCR/western/physiology, not by RNA-seq.

checks: 6 samples match S4.17.p1 (3 GAS MI4KO + 3 GAS MI4OE)

ownership.reasoning: GEO series links PMID 33042761; sample count, tissue and genotypes match the paper's GAS assay.

alignment.reasoning: rsem_count columns equal metadata title exactly (inspect: title 6/6). grp from the title prefix MKO/MOE, consistent with characteristics genotype (IRF4 knock out / IRF4 overexpression).

matrix.reasoning: File named rsem_count; 84% integer values with fractional values (RSEM expected counts), library sizes 19-29 M; data_processing: Bowtie2 + RSEM v1.2.15, TMM. Matches the paper's input (S4.17.p1). Would be rounded for a count model.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: all 6 samples are sedentary GAS muscle differing only by IRF4 genotype (MI4KO vs MI4OE); no metadata column or paper statement places any sequenced animal in an exercise condition (S2.5.p1, S4.17.p1, GEO characteristics). The requested estimand (exercise effect on gene expression) is not identifiable from these data. The genotype contrast MI4OE vs MI4KO is a different estimand and is not run here.

candidates.reason_rejected: Genotype effect, not an exercise effect; manufacturing it as the exercise answer would misstate the estimand.

design.reasoning: The request asks how exercise affects gene expression. The only grouping column is genotype (IRF4 knock out / IRF4 overexpression). No exercise, training, running or time-after-exercise factor exists.

discrepancies.data: GEO characteristics food = High fat diet
